# Driver Requirements Checklist: macOS Passthrough Release Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for Core Audio stability, no-hang behavior, route readiness, and pre-recording passthrough gates.
**Created**: 2026-06-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [X] CHK001 Are pre-recording stability gates defined without requiring long-duration manual replay evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001]
- [X] CHK002 Are short smoke evidence requirements complete for local speech, remote audio, no-loopback observation, route state, CPU/no-hang, and inactive recording/upload status? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [X] CHK003 Are all required no-hang target surfaces explicitly named, including macOS Sound, Chrome or Opera, Zoom, and Telemost? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contract no-hang]
- [X] CHK004 Are Core Audio readiness requirements clear that device visibility alone is insufficient proof of live audio readiness? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract no-hang]

## Requirement Clarity

- [X] CHK005 Is the `coreaudiod` CPU release threshold quantified with both percent and duration? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Contract no-hang]
- [X] CHK006 Is the no-hang responsiveness threshold quantified for audio settings surfaces? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [X] CHK007 Are route state terms such as ready, stale, degraded, blocked, failed, repair, and recheck distinguishable enough for task generation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [X] CHK008 Is the expected safe public running state defined for idle virtual devices before a Core Audio client uses them? [Clarity, Plan §Performance Goals]

## Requirement Consistency

- [X] CHK009 Are the pre-recording no-recording boundaries consistent across user stories, functional requirements, success criteria, and plan constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-001, Plan §Constraints]
- [X] CHK010 Are the no-hang targets consistent between the spec, plan, and no-hang evidence contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Scale/Scope, Contract no-hang]
- [X] CHK011 Are Bluetooth and AirPods-class routes consistently treated as pilot or blocked/not accepted unless separately proven? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [X] CHK012 Can CPU, no-hang, route visibility, alive state, and running state outcomes be objectively recorded as release-hardening evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK013 Are skipped browser or meeting targets required to be marked blocked/not accepted rather than passed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Contract evidence]
- [X] CHK014 Are build, runtime probe, no-hang, short smoke, diagnostics, and UX gates represented as required validation categories before implementation acceptance? [Traceability, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-009]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [X] CHK015 Are startup enumeration races covered when audio settings surfaces inspect devices before the app bridge is fully ready? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK016 Are natural silence, mute, loud remote audio, and intermittent network outage included as short smoke ambiguity cases? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [X] CHK017 Is full long-duration replay before recording exists explicitly handled as a deferred gate rather than an ambiguous blocker? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Contract deferred-recording]
